cases.name: public-part-GEO-OP-ABC
cases.why: PITFALL: any 3-alphanumeric tail after the last hyphen is stripped, so a test identifier like GEO-OP-ABC becomes GEO-OP. Registered numbers may not contain '-', so this only affects what is broadcast. compare_key is what identification compares (public part, upper case).

cases.name: public-part-FIN87astrdge12k8-
cases.why: An empty tail is not stripped. compare_key is what identification compares (public part, upper case).

cases.name: public-part--xyz
cases.why: Nothing before the hyphen: unchanged. compare_key is what identification compares (public part, upper case).
